title: I'm an ER doctor. After decades without touching code, I built 3 websites with AI in one month — on my phone.
why_read: A personal, feel-good story of a non-programmer building simple websites entirely via AI conversation, interesting as an anecdote about AI-assisted coding accessibility but not technically deep.
analysis: This is a first-person account from an ER doctor with minimal coding background who built three simple interactive websites using AI chat tools entirely on a phone. It's a good illustration of how far no-code/AI-assisted development has come for hobbyist projects, but it doesn't offer technical depth, architecture discussion, or lessons applicable to professional engineering practice. Interest is mainly as a human-interest data point about AI democratizing basic web development rather than as instructive technical content.
